latest_release.name: @effect/openapi-generator@4.1.5
latest_release.body:
### Patch Changes

- [#10659](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/pull/10659) [`1f124c3`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/1f124c36f8bd6b51890e84c25da102a9e8225833) Thanks @effect-bot! - Fix `httpapi` generation to produce type-correct declarations for buffered binary bodies and SSE responses.

- [#10664](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/pull/10664) [`dcaf897`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/dcaf89756c2dcf0ed36f3cfc7671d2bf854ac1ab) Thanks @tim-smart! - Fix strict compilation of SSE methods generated with `httpclient-type-only` by preserving the declared event type.

- [#10793](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/pull/10793) [`3412c77`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/3412c77ed6d6f5952c7a0fb02e7b196528872c63) Thanks @gcanti! - When an endpoint accepted both multipart and URL-encoded forms, generated HTTP clients sent a multipart request but required callers to supply the fields from the URL-encoded schema. Both client formats now use the multipart schema for the payload argument, so TypeScript checks the fields the client sends.

- [#10763](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/pull/10763) [`f3961b9`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/f3961b94eb77f8a82ad0b383d8e0dbee2fc4688f) Thanks @haranishi! - Generate client and HttpApi operations from local OpenAPI Path Item references.

- [#10773](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/pull/10773) [`ca9de3c`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/ca9de3c912ddb035a52b0f3f24e36ac453e417ae) Thanks @gcanti! - Reject OpenAPI patch moves that use an array property such as `length` as the source.

- [#10625](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/pull/10625) [`94fe28e`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/94fe28e8c5fc40fbdbd91ce579fbe0f5a60242dd) Thanks @gcanti! - Fix generated HTTP client path parameter types and serialization according to OpenAPI `style` and `explode`.
  
  When regenerating clients, pass numeric, boolean, and array path arguments directly instead of converting them to strings.

- [#10569](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/pull/10569) [`2402fe3`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/2402fe3baf815836bd0ca75035b51b209b46fd6b) Thanks @gcanti! - Add the experimental `Codegen.Module` builder and fix recursive initialization, name collisions, generated types, and symbol identity in schema and OpenAPI generation.
  
  Remove `SchemaRepresentation.toCodeDocument`, `CodeDocument`, `Artifact`, and `makeCode`. Generate schema source with `Codegen.Module.addSchemas` and `print`; construct `{ runtime, Type }` directly instead of calling `makeCode`.
  
  Custom `toCode` callbacks must interpolate supplied argument strings unchanged and return supported schema/type expressions. Move unsupported code, such as functions with local declarations, into imported helpers.
  
  The `@effect/openapi-generator/OpenApiTransformer` module is removed. Use the `OpenApiGenerator` service to generate from an OpenAPI spec, selecting the output with `format`.
  
  Some nullable OpenAI objects, such as `Batch.errors`, now strip undeclared fields and no longer expose index signatures; use their declared fields instead.
- Updated dependencies [[`3e2030b`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/3e2030b43e86a60113f2f32671076ff3b1d84ce4), [`f9f5f9d`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/f9f5f9de9431a6ac47b249a443ba999c67c35ac2), [`eecfff5`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/eecfff5048ce64fbbfeb80ea078098bf0b2a8885), [`7e9e5df`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/7e9e5dfee02553f2c3dc9d51d69ccde6874fe2fe), [`ddd142f`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/ddd142f75ac67d3f77ebf5dfe54fc20fd1773069), [`2bd41fe`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/2bd41fe10f14f3b99b08fba0bfe4755fd40952fe), [`36e335a`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/36e335a520db6e94efde0d951f34cbb99b56e7ce), [`7c36414`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/commit/7c36414f24def13a05144a81cf20bc511b05ca85), [`284b978`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/ef

add first-class support for tasks extension
Why not refuse to start the program if two (or more) tagged errors used in an effect have the same _tag?

# Effect

Effect is a library for building robust, maintainable, type-safe, and production grade applications in TypeScript. It helps you handle the hard problems at scale: typed errors, dependency injection, structured concurrency, scheduling, tracing, and unified schema validation.

> **Effect 4.x is a long-term support (LTS) release.** If you are upgrading from Effect 3.x, follow the [migration guide](MIGRATION.md).

## Installation

```sh
npm install effect
```

## Requirements

- **TypeScript 5.9 or newer.** TypeScript 7 is recommended for the best performance and compatibility with [Effect's TypeScript tooling](https://github.com/Effect-TS/tsgo#installation).
- **Node.js 22.19 or newer** is the general minimum for running Effect on Node.js.
- **Strict type-checking:** the `strict` flag must be enabled in your `tsconfig.json`.

## Links

- [Website](https://effect.website): documentation, guides, and news
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/effect-ts): ask questions, share what you're building, and talk to the core team
- [Community](https://effect.website/community-hub): meetups and events, or bring Effect to your own
- [Issues](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/issues): bug reports and feature requests
- [Jobs](https://effect.website/effect-jobs): companies hiring Effect developers
- Follow us on [X](https://x.com/EffectTS_), [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/effect-ts.bsky.social), and [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/effect-ts)

## Let's talk

Whether your team is considering Effect, rolling it out, or already running it in production, we'd love to hear from you: what you're building, what works, and what you need from Effect next.

- **Talk to the maintainers.** Introduce your team on [Discord](https://discord.gg/effect-ts) or email [contact@effectful.co](mailto:contact@effectful.co). We're happy to connect privately on Slack or Discord for feedback and help with adoption.
- **Production support.** We're exploring how to better support teams running Effect in production. If your organization has specific support needs, let's discuss them.
- **Adoption help.** Our [adoption partners](https://effect.website/adoption-partners) offer implementation, consulting, team extension, training, and commercial support.

Feedback from teams using and evaluating Effect directly shapes what we stabilize and build next.

## Long-term support

Teams depend on Effect for systems they expect to run for years. Effect 4.x is a long-term support (LTS) release with the following guarantees:

- At least three years of support, including bug and security fixes.
- Bug fixes for one year after the next major version is released.
- Security fixes for two years after the next major version is released.

Stable APIs reserve breaking changes for major releases. APIs marked unstable may change in minor releases, and experimental APIs may change in patch releases.

## Effect v3

The Effect v3 source code is available on the [`v3`](https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect/tree/v3) branch, which is also where issues and pull requests meant for Effect v3 should be targeted. To upgrade, see the [migration guide](MIGRATION.md).
